name: dikma-testes
description: Testes automáticos: regras de segurança do Firestore e rotinas do GitHub (no emulador do Firebase) e as telas do site no modo demonstração (navegador Chromium)

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=tap --test-reporter-destination=resultado.tap regras.test.mjs rotinas.test.mjs avisos.test.mjs planilhas.test.mjs situacao.test.mjs acessos.test.mjs limpeza.test.mjs feriados.test.mjs fotos.test.mjs fotos-arquivo.test.mjs queda-zero.test.mjs plano.test.mjs treinos.test.mjs escala-troca.test.mjs folha-ficha.test.mjs padrao.test.mjs ferias.test.mjs efetivo-dia.test.mjs filtro-freq.test.mjs mover-rota.test.mjs contrato.test.mjs medicao.test.mjs tratativas.test.mjs processos.test.mjs inspecoes.test.mjs funcoes.test.mjs oms.test.mjs excel-relatorio.test.mjs incremental.test.mjs execucao.test.mjs pessoas.test.mjs
